name: first_segment_from_clear_brief
prompt: 使用 $ai-video-segment-director，把这个需求拆成第一段：做一条 45 秒 9:16 写实短片，一个年轻快递员在雨夜把一份重要包裹送到旧楼。先给脚本结构、角色锚点、第一段 3 张分镜图提示词和即梦提示词。
must_check: starts from the clear requirement rather than asking for an article
plans only the first segment
includes character and style anchors
separates storyboard image prompts from Jimeng video prompt
states human Jimeng operation boundary
must_not_do: generate later segment storyboard prompts before a returned video exists

name: next_segment_requires_returned_video
prompt: 使用 $ai-video-segment-director，继续第二段。我还没把第一段成片发给你，但你先把第二段分镜和提示词都做出来。
must_check: blocks or warns that previous generated video is required for continuity
offers a provisional outline only if clearly marked as provisional
asks for the original previous video or representative frames
must_not_do: produce final second segment storyboard and prompt as if continuity was verified

name: visible_dialogue_control
prompt: 使用 $ai-video-segment-director，为 10 秒片段写即梦提示词：同一个主角要在画面里开口说一句粤语，不是旁白。
must_check: requires visible mouth/lip movement
locks language/accent and on-screen speech mode
allocates enough timing for speech
includes negative prompt against voice-over or off-screen narration
must_not_do: omit face angle or timing requirements

name: returned_video_review
prompt: 使用 $ai-video-segment-director，检查我回传的第 2 段视频，判断能不能进入第 3 段，并告诉我下一段必须继承什么。
must_check: uses pass/rerun decision language
checks identity, costume, voice, space direction, prop state, style, and ending frame
records actual ending state
turns review findings into next-segment constraints
must_not_do: design the next segment without first summarizing the reviewed ending state

name: prompt_only_with_references
prompt: 使用 $ai-video-segment-director。我已经有 @视频1、@图片1、@图片2、@图片3，只需要一条 12 秒的即梦提示词，不要重新拆脚本。
must_check: selects prompt-only mode
does not redo the full production brief unless missing constraints block the prompt
maps each @ reference to a time beat
includes continuity and negative constraints
